component.name: Dadhichi
component.summary: A modern, AI-first, agent-native IDE written in Rust

description.p: Dadhichi is not another code editor with a chat sidebar. It is a development environment designed from the kernel up around autonomous AI agents working alongside humans — model-agnostic, offline-first, MCP-native, and extensible through sandboxed WASM plugins.

ul.li: A microkernel with an event bus, command layer, and service registry
A model-agnostic AI runtime with fallback routing and prompt caching
Autonomous agents that plan, act, reflect, and verify
A permission-gated MCP tool layer and incremental workspace index
Sandboxed, fuel-metered WASM plugins from a signed marketplace

description.p: Coherent agent coordination: the tool-use loop now continues across re-planning rounds instead of stopping after a fixed number of tool calls, with a stall guard. Specialists are unified onto the one ReAct engine (no conflict), and native full-stack tools were added — project scaffolding (React/Vite, Angular, Next, Vue, Svelte, Express, FastAPI, Flask, Axum), build/test runners, and SQLite/Postgres queries — plus frontend, backend, and database specialists and a full-stack system prompt.

Agent Console polish: sticky scroll that stays put while you read history during a live run, an animated phase indicator (spinner plus thinking/running/delegated label), and colour-coded transcript lines. Plus dependency-free editor syntax highlighting and a visible, scrolling Explorer selection.

TUI polish and richer agent tools: a scrollable Agent Console with a scrollbar and PageUp/PageDown history, a collapsible Explorer (Ctrl-B), and new fs.grep / fs.glob search tools available to the ReAct agent and every delegated specialist.
Fix: the TUI agent now uses the tool-enabled ReAct agent for ordinary chat goals, so it can run shell commands and read/write files instead of only returning text.

Deep-agents delegation: sub-agents do isolated real work with their own tools and prebuilt skills, verified by an orchestrator-side critic and landed on the branch after auto-approval or a TUI Review panel. Plus editor usability (open/save, scroll, find, inline diagnostics) and keyless MCP connectors (playwright, sqlite, time).
A sandboxed virtual filesystem (state backend + path-jail) with fs.read/fs.write/fs.ls tools, and memory.write/memory.recall tools, shared across agents and their isolated-context sub-agents.
Human-in-the-loop approval gate for consequential tools (shell, file writes) and automatic conversation compaction to keep long runs inside the model's context window.
Foundational runtime: microkernel, AI runtime, agents, index, UI shell, WASM plugins, and cross-platform packaging.
